title: Phần 3: Đọc hiểu
description: Đọc đoạn văn rồi chọn đáp án đúng nhất.

passages.title: Remote Working
passages.text: Over the past decade, working from home has changed from a rare privilege into a normal arrangement for millions of employees. Companies discovered that many tasks could be completed just as well outside the office, and workers welcomed the chance to avoid long daily journeys. However, the shift has not been entirely positive. Some employees report that the line between work and private life has become blurred, and that they find it harder to stop thinking about their jobs in the evening. Younger staff, in particular, say they miss the informal conversations through which they once learned from more experienced colleagues. For this reason, a growing number of organisations now ask their teams to come to the office two or three days a week, hoping to combine the flexibility of home working with the social benefits of a shared workplace.

questions.question: According to the passage, why did companies accept home working?
options: Because offices had become too expensive to rent
Because they realised much work could be done equally well at home
Because governments required them to do so
Because employees refused to return to the office
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn nêu: "Companies discovered that many tasks could be completed just as well outside the office."

questions.question: What problem do some employees mention?
options: Work and personal life are no longer clearly separated
They have to travel more than before
Their computers are too slow at home
questions.explanation: Bài đọc nói "the line between work and private life has become blurred" - ranh giới giữa công việc và đời sống riêng bị mờ đi.

questions.question: Why do many organisations now ask staff to come in a few days a week?
options: To reduce the cost of electricity at home
To train employees in new software
To keep flexibility while restoring the social side of work
To check whether employees are really working
questions.explanation: Câu cuối nêu rõ mục đích: "to combine the flexibility of home working with the social benefits of a shared workplace."

questions.question: The word "blurred" in the passage is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation: "Blurred" nghĩa là mờ nhạt, không rõ ràng, đồng nghĩa với "unclear".

passages.title: Learning a Second Language
passages.text: It is often claimed that children acquire a second language effortlessly while adults struggle. The reality is more complicated. Children do tend to achieve a more native-like accent, probably because their brains remain highly sensitive to unfamiliar sounds. Adults, on the other hand, bring considerable advantages of their own: they already understand how grammar works, they can memorise vocabulary systematically, and they are able to study with a clear purpose in mind. Research suggests that in the first year of instruction, motivated adult learners frequently progress faster than children in reading and writing. What adults genuinely lack is not ability but exposure. A child may hear the target language for several hours every day, whereas an adult learner might practise for only two hours a week. When adults are given comparable amounts of meaningful contact with the language, the supposed gap narrows considerably.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Adults should not attempt to learn a second language
Accent is the most important part of language learning
Children are always better language learners than adults
The common belief about children learning faster is oversimplified
questions.explanation: Câu thứ hai nêu luận điểm chính: "The reality is more complicated" - thực tế phức tạp hơn quan niệm phổ biến.

questions.question: According to the passage, children's advantage lies mainly in:
options: achieving pronunciation closer to native speakers
questions.explanation: Bài đọc nêu "Children do tend to achieve a more native-like accent"; các lựa chọn còn lại là ưu thế của người lớn.

questions.question: What does the writer say adults really lack?
questions.explanation: Câu "What adults genuinely lack is not ability but exposure" khẳng định điều người lớn thiếu là sự tiếp xúc.

questions.question: In the first year of study, motivated adults often do better than children at:
questions.explanation: Bài đọc nêu: "motivated adult learners frequently progress faster than children in reading and writing."

questions.question: The phrase "the gap narrows" at the end of the passage suggests that the difference between adults and children:
questions.explanation: "Narrow" nghĩa là thu hẹp, nên khoảng cách giảm đi đáng kể chứ không biến mất hoàn toàn.
